what: A bold road drawing behind the section is revealed from the top as you scroll — progress = (screen center − box top) ÷ box height, the revealed end 30px melts softly. Scrolling back up hides it again. Bound straight to scroll with no curve

options.on: With parent, progress is measured from the parent box position (even if the image layer is pushed down inside the parent, it is based on the parent) — Brand uses parent
options.at: What fraction of the screen height the baseline sits at, default .5 (center)
options.soft: Blur length of the exposed edge (px), default 30

use: …

from.where: detail.html .dt-road (cream road at 160 weight behind the process page — original function.js setProcessRoad: progress = (innerHeight/2 − .process-inner top) ÷ height, ::before mask linear-gradient(black 0, black calc(p − 30px), transparent p), on every Lenis scroll)
